<explanation>
Technical Q&A format establishing a pattern of URL examples with query parameters, expecting continuation of the second URL example.

The question concerns query parameter ordering and flag behavior, so the second URL must contrast with the first (e.g., missing `foo=bar` or different ordering of `?flag`).

Final token `?flag` is the start of a second URL query string (`https://example.com/?flag`), requiring completion — likely `&foo=bar` or a similar parameter, or a closing statement about the flag's position.
"First URL: `https://example.com/?foo=bar&flag`
Second URL: `https://example.com/?flag`" — the pattern suggests the second URL demonstrates a different scenario with the same `flag` parameter, likely followed by `&` or a description of its value/behavior.
</explanation>
